content_html:
CAUTION # naa life lo B.tech answer sheet lo guda intha pedha paragraphs rayaledhu….so read @ ur own risk n free time!!!

STARTING NOTE # konni mandi Fans cinema meedha nenu already petina comments chusi…..” Cinema chusina vallake review rase right undi…cinema chudakunda edo rasi janalani wrong impression loki teskelladhu…” ani class pekaru…..first lo emo anukunaa gaani cinema chusaka artham ayimdhi….Narakanu ni degaraaagaa chudakunda dani gurunchi em cheptham anatu….Cinema chudakunda comments petti cinema parledhu emo anna wrong impression tepinchinandhuku extremly SORRY, ipudu inka assalu review modaledathaa….

#SVSC n #Srimanthudu edho fluke lo Hit ayinantha mathranaaaa……..Mokhaniki Ponds powder (oh babu inka Ponds ni endorse cheyaledhu kadha) Santhoor powder koteskoni, Edhavaa Smile (I repeat) edhava Smile, epatiki nayam kaani jalubu tho kudinaaa gonthu esukoni venakaaa laaridu ninda jaanaaalu (adhe chutalani) esukoni cinema tesesthe chudaniki janaaalu veri vengalapallu kadhu….

assalu aa cinema lo em undhi ra ayyaaa edho interval and climax lo baaga jalubu chesina edupu gothutho matladatam thapaa (Srimanthudu lo chesindhe gaa)….#MB cinema chusedhe performance kosam (oka Nijam oka okkadu Pokiri Businessman Nenokkadine)…….nanu adagachu #PK ki vacha acting aniii??? akkada radhu kabatee ikada chusedhi…….Cinema ella unaa parledhu Babu andham ga unaadu anevalakki nenu chepedhi okate Koti ki velli 100 rs peti MB posters konukoni Bedroom lo petukondi

assalu Srimanthude logic lekunda ella adindho artham kadhu naaku, endhukante apudepudo graamani dathathu tesukuna babu gaaru punadi rayi eyadaniki 1yr patindhi, cinema lo mathram pusuku mani chesesthadu…..yeah Telugu cinemalo logics vethakudadhu correctee kaani Babu gari fans feeling enti ante migitha Hero fans andharu illiterates and caste based fans memu okaalaaamee Class and Intelligent audience anni…andhuke chepaaa

nanaaa ki sudden gaaa gunde agutheeee…..hospital ki tesukelakundaaa Nanagaaru Manchi Mata matladandi Nanagaru antadu….aaaa paythyam endho artham kaadhu

ok lets not divert……inko mata em antunaru ante Srikanth Addala adadhidam ga testhe Babu thapu enti aa?? Cinema Hit avuthe credit babu gari story selecting capabilities adhe dhaaam ante Srinu vaytla, Sukumar n Srikanth addala thappaaa??? Distributors dabbulu petedhi Babu ni chusi vere valani chusi kadhu, so jagrathaga undakarledhaa?? eedikaynaa aadeee nayam….cinema release aye mundhu tarvatha guda nene kartha karma kriya ani chepukunaadu

Cinema motham lo Bala tripura sundari song naaku baagha nachindhi…..endhukante Babu gaaru kothaga try chesindhi edhayna undhi ante adhe aa patalonee (& again migitha vaalu edavaleru kabate ediche capabilty unodini edavamanedhi)

inkonthamandi emo…family values thelinolle cinema baaledhu ani publicity chesthunaru ani antunaaru…….correcte ee cinema chusake artham ayindhi, epudu evari pani lo vaalu busy ga unde nenu naa thamudu….erra cinema chusavantagaaa baanee unavaaa ani phone lo matladukunam 😛

ipudu #PVP samstha gurunchi…..nee degara dabulu ekuvaa unaayi ani telusu dabulu tho paatu buraaa vadatam guda nerchuko….nee interview chusanu andhulo nuvu chepavu ee cinema shooting 100+ days chesamu roju shooting lo bhari janaalu settings tho edho 100 pellilu chusanu ana feeling vachindhi ani, apudanaaa neeku Hero n Director kalisi ninu nakinchesthunaaru ani gurthinchalelapoyavaaa?? nuvu edho AVM Vijaya lanti production samshtahala place lo PVP ni chudaliani undhi ani chepavu…adhemo gaani vaalaaaga thata buta sadhadam mathram pakkaa

ipudu assalu Hero babu Srikanth Addala….oka Kotha Bangaru Lokam thapa migitha cinemalu ani adadidam ga tesaavu…ok SVSC ante edho multistarrer Godari slang lo cinema knchm kothaga undhi kada ani chusinandhuku…inka prati cinema story lekundaa…bhari slang lo classulu pekesthe kastam babu….kadhu kudadadhu nenu naa style lone testha antavaaa….poni Budget anaa cntrl lo petukotam nerchukooo anni mandhi artistulu antha bhaari settingulu avasaramaa??

bayata chalamandhi idhi cinema kadhu Serial antunaaru….but please Serial vaalu gudaa ee cinema lo 2 hrs editing lo tesi 30 mins episode kinda vadukuntaaru

illa routine cinemalu tesedapudu Mass Masala namukodam better endhukante B & C centers lo emotions ekuvaaa valaki talk tho sambandham undadhu chusestharanthe, Class ni namukunte illa nee first 2 days collections guda rakundaa naakipothaaruu….Overseas lo advance book chesukunollu refund aduguthunarantaa
